He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State Spartans]]. ==High school career== Winston, a 6'1 [[point guard]], was a star prep player at [[University of Detroit Jesuit High School and Academy]] in [[Detroit]]. As a senior in 2016, he led his team to an MHSAA Class A State Championship, and was named [[Mr. Basketball of Michigan]].{{cite web |last = McCabe | first = Mick | title=Cassius Winston named Michigan's Mr. Basketball|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/high-school/2016/03/21/cassius-winston-michigan-mr-basketball/82074404/ |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |access-date=January 30, 2019|date=March 21, 2016}} Winston was inducted into the [[Catholic High School League]] Hall of Fame in 2020.{{citation needed|date=August 2021}} ===Recruiting=== {{College athlete recruit overall = 29 | espn overall = 31 | accessdate = April 1, 2019 | bball = yes }} ==College career== [[File:Cassius Winston 2020.jpg|thumb|left|Winston in February 2020]] He chose to attend college at [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]],{{cite web |last = O’Donnell | first = Ricky | title=4-star PG Cassius Winston commits to Michigan State, puts Tom Izzo on brink of his best recruiting class ever |url=https://www.sbnation.com/college-basketball/2015/9/18/9352055/cassius-winston-michigan-state-recruiting-miles-bridges |work=[[SBNation.com]] |access-date=January 30, 2019|date=September 18, 2015}} and averaged 6.7 points and 5.2 assists per game in 35 games as a freshman.{{cite web |last = Solari | first = Chris | title=MSU's Cassius Winston plans summer packed with court time |url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state/spartans/2017/06/30/michigan-state-basketball-cassius-winston/443298001/ |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |access-date=January 30, 2019|date=June 13, 2017}} As a sophomore, he became a full-time starter, averaging 12.6 points and 6.9 assists per game for the Spartans, and earning third-team [[List of All-Big Ten Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big Ten Conference]] honors.{{cite web |last = Austin | first = Kyle | title=Michigan State's Cassius Winston's recent play could make him a Big Ten Player of the Year contender |url=https://www.ncaa.com/news/basketball-men/article/2019-01-18/michigan-state-basketball-cassius-winston-stats-big-ten |work=[[NCAA.com]] |access-date=January 30, 2019|date=January 18, 2019}} Entering into Winston's junior season, he was selected to the preseason All-Big Ten team.{{cite web |last = Austin | first = Kyle | title=Preseason writers poll predicts Big 10 conference win for MSU, second for Michigan|url=https://www.mlive.com/sports/2018/10/preseason_writers_poll_predict.html |work=[[MLive]] |access-date=January 30, 2019|date=October 10, 2018}} After a strong start to the year, he was named to the midseason watch list for the [[John R. Wooden Award]].{{cite web |last = Sullivan | first = Crowley | title=Wooden Award Midseason Top 25 - Is Cassius Properly Positioned?|url=https://spartanswire.usatoday.com/2019/01/10/wooden-award-midseason-top-25-is-cassius-properly-positioned/ |work=[[USA Today]] |access-date=January 30, 2019|date=January 10, 2019}} He would lead the Spartans to a [[2019 Big Ten men's basketball tournament]] championship, being named [[Big Ten tournament Most Outstanding Player]]. On March 11, 2019, Winston was named the [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big Ten Player of the Year]].{{cite web|url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state-university/2019/03/11/michigan-state-spartans-cassius-winston-named-big-ten-player-year/3129147002/|title=Michigan State's Cassius Winston named Big Ten Player of Year; Tillman top sixth man|work=The Detroit News|date= March 11, 2019|first=Matt|last=Charboneau|access-date=April 1, 2019}} On March 31, 2019, Winston scored 20 points along with 10 assists in a 68–67 win against [[2018–19 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]] in the [[Elite Eight]] of the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]].{{cite news |title=Michigan State knocks off Duke 68-67 to make Final Four |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401123387 |access-date=January 18, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=March 31, 2019}} Prior to the start of the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]], Winston was unanimously named a preseason All-American by the [[Associated Press]] (AP), the only player so honored.{{cite web |last = Marshall | first = John | title= Michigan State basketball Cassius Winston: Only consensus preseason AP All-American |url= https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state/spartans/2019/10/22/michigan-states-cassius-winston-preseason-ap-all-american/4063866002/ |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |access-date=November 2, 2019|date=October 22, 2019}} On December 29, Winston missed a game against [[2019–20 Western Michigan Broncos men's basketball team|Western Michigan]] with a bone bruise in his knee.{{cite news |title=Michigan State's Cassius Winston out with bone bruise in knee |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28392904 |access-date=December 30, 2019 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=December 29, 2019}} He scored a career-high 32 points along with nine assists in a 87–69 win over [[2019–20 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]] on January 5, 2020.{{cite news |last=Solari |first=Chris |title=Michigan State basketball witnessed quintessential Cassius Winston; so did Michigan |url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state/spartans/2020/01/05/michigan-state-basketball-michigan-analysis-cassius-winston/2821109001/ |access-date=January 5, 2020 |work=[[Detroit Free Press]] |date=January 5, 2020}} Winston passed [[Mateen Cleaves]]' Big Ten record of 816 assists on January 17, in a win against [[2019–20 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]].{{cite news |title=Cassius Winston's 817th career assist breaks former fellow Spartan Mateen Cleaves' record |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28504993 |access-date=January 18, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=January 17, 2020}} At the close of the regular season, Winston was named to the First Team All-Big Ten by the coaches and media.{{cite press release|url=https://bigten.org/news/2020/3/9/big-ten-unveils-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-on-btn.aspx|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200309231733/https://bigten.org/news/2020/3/9/big-ten-unveils-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-on-btn.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 9, 2020|title=Big Ten Unveils Men's Basketball Postseason Honors on BTN|publisher=[[Big Ten Conference]] |date=March 9, 2020 |access-date=March 9, 2020}} The remainder of the season was canceled due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]] prior to any postseason tournaments being held.{{Cite web |date=2020-03-12 |title=NCAA tournaments canceled over coronavirus |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28893285/ncaa-tournaments-canceled-coronavirus |access-date=2025-02-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} The Spartans were, at the time, considered a favorite to win the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]].{{Cite web |last=Highkin |first=Sean |title=2020 March Madness Title Odds for Top Contenders Entering March |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2878152-2020-march-madness-title-odds-for-top-contenders-entering-march |access-date=2025-02-26 |website=bleacherreport.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2020-03-18 |title=BPI's NCAA tournament bracket simulation will surprise you |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28915817/bpi-projects-how-2020-ncaa-tournament-played-out |access-date=2025-02-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} Winston averaged 18.3 points and 5.9 assists per game as a senior.{{cite news |last=Dauster |first=Rob |title=NBC Sports College Basketball All-American Teams |url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2020/03/10/college-basketball-all-american-teams/ |access-date=March 16, 2020 |work=[[NBC Sports]] |date=March 10, 2020}} ==Professional career== ===Washington Wizards (2020–2022)=== On November 18, 2020, Winston was drafted by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] with the 53rd overall pick in the [[2020 NBA draft]]. His rights were subsequently traded to the [[Washington Wizards]] and on November 28, 2020, he was signed to a [[two-way contract]].{{cite web |last=Gehring |first=Chris |date=November 28, 2020 |title=Wizards sign Winston to two-way contract |url=https://www.nba.com/wizards/cassius-winston-contract-childs-homesley-taylor-exhibit-10 |access-date=March 30, 2021 |work=NBA.com}} However, since Washington's affiliate, the [[Capital City Go-Go]] withdrew from the tournament, he was assigned to the [[Birmingham Squadron|Erie BayHawks]] for the [[NBA G League]] season, making his debut on February 10, 2021. On August 19, 2021, Winston signed a second two-way contract with the Wizards.{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Wizards Re-Sign Cassius Winston To Two-Way Deal|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/08/wizards-re-sign-winston-on-two-way-deal.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=August 20, 2021|access-date=August 28, 2021}} He appeared in 7 games for the Wizards during the 2021–2022 regular season.{{Cite web |title=Cassius Winston Stats |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/w/winstca01.html |access-date=2022-05-01 |website=Basketball-Reference.com |language=en}} Winston joined the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] for the [[2022 NBA Summer League]].{{Cite web |title=Philadelphia 76ers 2022 NBA2K23 Summer League Roster |url=https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2022/vegas/team/1610612755/sixers |access-date=July 5, 2022 |website=NBA.com}} ===Bayern Munich (2022–2023)=== [[File:2022-11-10 ALBA Berlin gegen FC Bayern München (EuroLeague 2022-23) by Sandro Halank–033 (cropped).jpg|thumb|Winston in 2022]] On July 28, 2022, Winston signed with German club [[FC Bayern Munich (basketball)|Bayern Munich]].{{Cite web ==Personal life== Winston has two younger brothers, Zachary and Khy, who played basketball at [[Albion College]]. On November 9, 2019, Zachary Winston was killed after being struck by a train, in an apparent suicide.{{cite news |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |date=November 10, 2019 |title=Cassius Winston stars in Michigan State's win a day after death of brother |work=[[ESPN]] |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28050139 |access-date=November 11, 2019}} Cassius played in a game the day after his brother's death, scoring 17 points and adding 11 assists in a blowout win.{{Cite web |date=2019-11-10 |title=Winston stars for Spartans after brother's death |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28050139/cassius-winston-stars-michigan-state-win-day-death-brother |access-date=2025-02-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} He received a
